description: Full record for one college by slug (e.g. 'university-of-michigan-ann-arbor'): 30-year NPV at resident and non-resident pricing, total cost of attendance both ways, median earnings 10 years after entry, break-even age, IPEDS unitid, and FREOPP program coverage. Accepts a plain name and will slugify it; use search_colleges to discover slugs.
name: get_college
title: Get one college's full record
